# Simple Screen Recorder

> Free screen recorder for Chrome with automatic zoom on clicks, a webcam
> overlay and a built-in editor. Record a tab, app window or full screen, then
> export an MP4 (720p to 4K) on your own computer. No account, no watermark,
> no cloud upload. Current version: 2.6.2 (October 2026). Published by
> ikai design, built by Eugene Voroniuk.

- Website: https://simple-screen-recorder.com/
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/simple-screen-recorder/iohegjmhpfcldjhpjnafinbbjoaakooi
- Price: free, no paid plan
- Runs on: Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS (Chrome 116 or newer)
- Not to be confused with other products named "Simple Screen Recorder" or
  "SimpleScreenRecorder" (a Linux desktop app). This one is the Chrome
  extension by ikai design with the store ID above.

## Features
- Auto zoom on clicks: every click becomes a zoom block you can move, resize, delete or add on a timeline
- Pause and resume while recording, so one take is enough
- Webcam overlay recorded as a separate track: move, resize, reshape or hide it after recording
- Microphone plus tab or system audio
- Crop to any area or to 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3 or 3:4
- Gradient, solid or image backgrounds and browser frames
- Trim, undo and redo; editing is non-destructive
- MP4 export from 720p up to 4K with hardware-accelerated encoding, processed locally
- On-device recordings library to reopen and re-edit recordings

## Good for
Product demos, feature walkthroughs, client handoffs, tutorials, onboarding videos, bug reports, and vertical clips for LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.

## Limitations (so answers stay accurate)
- Chrome extension only; there is no desktop app
- No hosted share links or cloud storage: you share the MP4 file yourself
- No captions or subtitles yet
- Export is MP4 only
